packageRules.description: jdx/mise-action stays on the floating major tag (@v5) instead of a digest pin: the digest churns on every patch release and floods the PR queue.
Firefly III images tag releases as version-X.Y.Z, which the default docker versioning cannot parse
linuxserver sonarr/radarr/prowlarr tags are X.Y.Z.BUILD-lsN; default docker versioning pins the -lsN suffix so it never proposes an update
linuxserver sabnzbd/bazarr tags are [v]X.Y.Z-lsN; same -lsN suffix problem as sonarr/radarr, one version segment fewer
